title: Speaking — Rainy days
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on rainy days.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
Does it rain often where you live?
What do you enjoy doing when you cannot go out?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when bad weather led to an enjoyable alternative plan.
part2.closing: and explain why the alternative turned out well.

questions: What infrastructure matters most to cities with frequent heavy rain?
How does unreliable weather influence businesses that depend on visitors?
How has everyday life connected with rainy days changed for people of different ages?
